title: Safe Memory grant
description: What one agent may read, of which kinds, how far back, until when, and with which fields removed. There is no implicit grant: an agent with no grant reads nothing, and that is the default for every agent GB has not named.

agent.description: The calling agent's name, taken from the MCP client identity, never from a tool argument. An agent cannot name itself into a wider grant.

kinds.description: Event kinds this agent may read. Empty means nothing.

window_days.description: How far back the agent may see, in days from the read. 0 means today only. A query asking for more is not an error: it is silently clipped to the window, and the clip is one audit line.

expires.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime after which the grant is dead. Null means it does not expire on its own; GB revoking it is still the only other way it ends.

fields_redacted.description: Event fields stripped before the agent sees the row. `amount` for the Siri grant, so a spoken answer can never carry a price GB did not ask to be spoken.

note.description: Why GB granted this. Read by the settings page, never by the enforcement code.
